generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The bid is to be submitted through GOK k-Portal platform https://kppp.karnataka.gov.in only.

The Tenderer should obtain tender documents through K-portal web site (https://kppp.karnataka.gov.in at free of cost. Additional conditions and information also can be obtained through the above mentioned website

The contractor has to make his own arrangement for procurement of all materials required for the work. There is no departmental supply of materials.
Acceptance or Cancellation of the works or tender are reserved by Executive Engineer without giving any reasons for the same.

Security deposit (FSD) at the rate of 5% on the amount quoted by the contractor. If the amount quoted is lesser than the amount put to tender, the difference cost should be paid by the contractor, in favour of Executive Engineer in the form of DD/FDR at the time of Work Order.
After the Completion of the O & M should be duly handed over to the department with all records and equipments.

Staff requirements should be according to the Sanctioned Estimates. Staff attendance register should be duly maintained at the site by the contractor and should be produced at the time of visit by the department officer.
Log Book of machineries should be maintained for all works.
Consumable items register should be maintained at the site by the contractor and should be produced at the time of visit by the department officer.
The bidder rate should be qoute without GST

itemList.description:
OPERATION AND MAINTENANCE for 1st Year to 5th Year : Operation and maintenance of the scheme, which includes, providing technical staff, valveman, operators, and others who are required to run the system in complete manner and providing all materials & chemcials required, for operation of jack wells WTP /pipeline repair works 1. Regular maintenance of civil structures like Jack well form WTP, PWS, Master balancing tank, pump house and all other civil structures. The maintenance of civil structures consists of all kinds of repairs to damaged structures, cleaning and washing, however painting for civil structures shall be once in a year. 2. Repairs and replacement of damaged pipe line, valves etc.if found necessary. It includes cost of materials and labour charges and also monitoring of the systems. The maintenance involves raw water rising main, gravity mains, pure water rising mains. maintaining the required discharge in the each pipe including controlling all the valves so that each village will get required designed quantum of water. 3. Operation and maintenance of water treatment plant including dosing of required quantity of alum ,chlorine and other chemicals including replacement of sand / filter media as required as per standard of established norms from time to time. Maintaining the quality of water as per the guide lines CPHEEO mannual and ISI specifications including cost of testing of water at laboratory at regular intervals. 4. Operation and maintenance of all kinds of pumping machinery, other mechanical components of this scheme including SCADA, electrical maintenance covering all repairs / replacement of transformers / Electrical cable / switch board / replacement of burnt parts of machinery All the above repairs & maintenace will be carried out as per the direction of the Engineer-in-charge for satisfactory functioning of the scheme to provide designed LPCD of drinking water to all the habitatants of the Project villages. Note: Helpers / Watchman / Valve man / Technical staff made available round the clock for maintenance period at Jackwell, WTP and Pure water Sump points. The contactor should maintain a Log Book on the working of pumping machinery at Jackwell, WTP etc. The payment will be made by the Engineer-in-charge satisfactoty report.
The bidder shall quote for the 5year O & M cost against the total estimated cost of Rs.34779581.00 The year wise breakup amount shall be calculated as per the percentage given below. 
Year 1: 18.07%
Year 2: 19.00%
Year 3: 19.95%
Year 4: 20.95%
Year 5: 21.99%
